intro: Bengaluru rewards visitors with leafy streets, grand palaces, buzzing markets and some of India's best South Indian food. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Namma Metro has Green, Purple and Yellow lines; fares ₹10-90, smart card ₹50.
BMTC buses cover the city but are slow and crowded at peak times.
Use the metro to dodge traffic; Google Maps shows metro and bus schedules.
Uber, Ola and Rapido work well; auto-rickshaws are cheaper for short hops.
Driving yourself is stressful; hire a car with a driver instead.
Walking is fine in small pockets, but pavements are patchy and traffic heavy.

vidhana_soudha.name: Vidhana Soudha
vidhana_soudha.price_text: Free to view from outside; interior visits need prior permission
vidhana_soudha.hours: Grounds viewable daily; building not open to casual visitors
vidhana_soudha.tip: Best seen lit up at night from the front lawn. Photography of the building from outside is fine.

wonderla.name: Wonderla (Bangalore)
wonderla.price_text: ≈ INR 1,000–1,500 adult day ticket; check current rates online
wonderla.hours: Usually 11:00–18:00; confirm opening days on the day
wonderla.tip: It is far south of the city, so allow most of a day and go on a weekday to avoid queues.

cafe_coffee_day.name: Café Coffee Day
cafe_coffee_day.price_text: ≈ INR 150–300 for a coffee and snack
cafe_coffee_day.hours: Most outlets roughly 09:00–23:00; varies by branch
cafe_coffee_day.tip: A reliable air-conditioned coffee stop with many branches; use it as a rest point rather than a destination.

kr_market.name: Krishna Rajendra Market (City Market)
kr_market.price_text: Free to enter; pay for what you buy
kr_market.hours: Early morning to evening; liveliest before 10:00
kr_market.tip: Come early for flowers, fruit and spice stalls. Keep valuables close in the crowds.

lalbagh.name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden
lalbagh.tip: Go at opening for cool air and birds. The glasshouse and old trees are the highlights.

cubbon_park.name: Cubbon Park
cubbon_park.tip: Walk the shaded paths in the morning, then cross to the nearby museums and Vidhana Soudha.

mg_road_walk.name: MG Road and Brigade Road walk
mg_road_walk.price_text: Free to walk; pay for shopping and food
mg_road_walk.tip: A good first-evening stroll for shops and cafes. Use the metro to skip the traffic.

indiranagar_walk.name: Indiranagar 100 Feet Road walk
indiranagar_walk.price_text: Free to walk; pay for food and drinks
indiranagar_walk.tip: The city's cafe and restaurant strip. Wander the side streets for smaller local spots.

koramangala_food.name: Koramangala food streets
koramangala_food.price_text: ≈ INR 200–500 per person for a meal
koramangala_food.tip: Busy with students and tech workers. Try a local thali or dosa place rather than chains.

bull_temple.name: Bull Temple (Dodda Basavana Gudi)
bull_temple.tip: A short visit near Basavanagudi. Remove shoes and dress modestly.

iskcon.name: ISKCON Temple Bangalore
iskcon.price_text: Free entry; some areas may charge a small fee
iskcon.hours: Roughly 07:15–13:00 and 16:00–20:30; check on the day
iskcon.tip: Busy at festival times. Go in the late afternoon and expect a security check.

tipu_palace.name: Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace
tipu_palace.tip: A small, quick stop for history lovers. Combine it with the nearby City Market.

bangalore_palace.name: Bangalore Palace
bangalore_palace.tip: Tudor-style palace with wood carvings. Allow an hour and check if events close parts of it.

commercial_street.name: Commercial Street shopping
commercial_street.price_text: Free to browse; pay for purchases
commercial_street.tip: Good for clothes and fabrics. Bargain politely and go on a weekday to avoid crowds.

nandi_hills.name: Nandi Hills day trip
nandi_hills.price_text: Free entry; pay for transport (≈ INR 1,500–3,000 by taxi round trip)
nandi_hills.tip: Leave the city very early for sunrise. It is about 60 km north, so plan transport in advance.

cubbon_museum.name: Visvesvaraya Industrial and Technological Museum
cubbon_museum.tip: Good for families and rainy afternoons. Next to Cubbon Park.

ulsoor_lake.name: Ulsoor Lake walk
ulsoor_lake.tip: A calm early-morning loop near MG Road. Skip boating if water quality looks poor.

dosa_breakfast.name: South Indian dosa breakfast
dosa_breakfast.price_text: ≈ INR 80–250 for a dosa and coffee
dosa_breakfast.tip: Order a masala dosa and filter coffee. Go before 09:00 for the freshest batch.

cubbon_art.name: National Gallery of Modern Art
cubbon_art.tip: A quiet gallery near Cubbon Park. Check opening days before you go.

stays.why: Central and on the metro. Walk to Cubbon Park and the shops; easy rides to most sights.
Best for food and nightlife. Many cafés, bars and restaurants within walking distance.
Young, lively area with cafés and startups. Good value stays; traffic can be heavy.
Quiet, local south Bengaluru. Close to Lalbagh and traditional food spots; metro nearby.

food: Start the day with a masala dosa and filter coffee at a stand-up 'darshini' — usually ₹60–150.
Try a South Indian thali (meals) at lunch: rice, sambar, rasam and vegetables, often ₹150–350.
Bengaluru is famous for biryani; ask your hotel for a well-known local spot and go early.
Indiranagar and Koramangala have craft breweries and cafés; expect ₹300–600 for a beer.
Street food like chaat and idli is cheap and tasty, but choose busy stalls and drink bottled water.
more_time: Day trip to Mysuru: trains take about 2–3 hours each way. See the palace and Devaraja Market; check times on the day.
Sunrise at Nandi Hills: hire a car with driver, leave very early, and check the weather before you go.
Half-day to Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace and the nearby markets for history and shopping.
